patches.name: Bypass license check
patches.description: Bypasses pairip LicenseClientV3 license verification by preventing all license checks, paywall display, and error dialogs.

patches.name: Bypass pairip VM
patches.description: Bypasses pairip integrity verification VM by preventing StartupLauncher from invoking VMRunner, which avoids loading libpairipcore.so and executing signature checks.

patches.name: Disable FirebaseInitProvider
patches.description: Removes FirebaseInitProvider from AndroidManifest.xml. WARNING: Do NOT apply this patch — FirebaseInitProvider must be present for the app to work. This patch exists as a reference only.

patches.name: Dismiss Google Play error dialog (371 split research)
patches.description: Experimental JioTV 7.1.7 split-build patch. Suppresses LicenseClientV3 error handling only and does not disable VMRunner or StartupLauncher.

patches.name: Enable cleartext traffic
patches.description: Sets usesCleartextTraffic=true, extractNativeLibs=true, replaces pairip Application with JioTVApplication, and patches the network security config to allow cleartext HTTP traffic and user-installed CA certificates.

patches.name: Force-initialize pairip string class
patches.description: Forces initialization of pkOPEgq (pairip string decryption class) before OkHttp loads. Without this, Header.clinit accesses null fields causing NoClassDefFoundError for Hpack.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Bypasses ad-removal premium checks by forcing PremiumState.isRemoveAdPremium() to always return true.

patches.name: Remove certificate pinning
patches.description: Removes SSL/TLS certificate pinning for tv.media.jio.com and media.jio.com.

patches.name: Remove emulator detection
patches.description: Removes emulator and unsupported device detection checks in PermissionActivity.

patches.name: Remove root detection
patches.description: Removes root detection checks. Bypasses Firebase CommonUtils.isRooted() and Xposed framework detection.

patches.name: Remove split APK metadata
patches.description: Removes requiredSplitTypes and split-related meta-data from AndroidManifest.xml to allow standalone APK installation.

patches.name: Unlock Pro subscription
patches.description: Bypasses premium checks by forcing PremiumState.isPremium() to always return true.
